title: The Ark as communication device
statement: The Ark of the Covenant — the gold-plated chest built at Sinai to exact delivered specifications, from whose cover between the cherubim the voice of Yahweh issued, lethal to mishandlers — is read, per the canon, as a technological artifact: a communication device linking the Israelite leadership to the alliance, its specifications, handling rules, and casualty record read as the texts' preserved operational knowledge; the corpus records the reading at the canon's level, with the ritual-symbolic account of mainstream scholarship in its own voice.

includes: The device reading: the delivered specifications (Exodus 25), the voice from the kapporet (Exodus 25:22; Numbers 7:89), the handling discipline and the Uzzah casualty (2 Samuel 6) read as operational memory
The office link: the communicating counterpart is the alliance of woh-claim-0028's presidency
The boundary of the artifact class: this record covers the Ark; other artifact readings (the menorah among them) are minted separately if the corpus develops them
excludes: Electrical or engineering reconstructions (the capacitor tradition of speculation); the record asserts the canon's device reading, not a schematic
The Ark's later history and location; the disappearance is not this record's question
Cinema-descended treasure narratives as engagement targets
Extension to temple furniture generally without records

source_references.locator: The canon's Ark material: the transmitter reading within the Sinai narrative
Exodus 25:10-22 (the specifications; the meeting voice from between the cherubim); the construction and handling material
2 Samuel 6:6-7 (the Uzzah episode, read as handling casualty)

alternatives.statement: The Ark is the empty throne / footstool of the invisible enthroned deity, standard ancient Near Eastern cult furniture; the mainstream account needs no device.
The lethality episodes are holiness theology (the danger of the sacred), not casualty records.
The device reading descends from the modern electrical-speculation lineage rather than from the texts.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0001 or woh-claim-0028 is revised or retired.
Source-language review changes the cited Exodus or Samuel observations.
Public prose begins publishing reconstructions or extending the reading to other artifacts without records, both of which this record excludes.
